text:
alex: Heads up — ran into an SDK vs REST mismatch in the onboarding sample app. Node SDK doesn't forward the optional `timeout_ms` field the REST endpoint accepts, so the app hangs waiting for a response when the model backend is slow. Repro steps below.

alex: Repro (local):
```js
// sample-app using @redwood/sdk
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood/gpt-3.5',
  prompt: 'hello',
  timeout_ms: 2000, // expected to abort after 2s
});
// hangs for ~30s then finally throws from underlying node fetch
```

alex: Meanwhile curl works as expected: the REST `/v1/generate` returns 504 after ~2s when we pass `timeout_ms`. So parity is off.

maria: Ugh. This is probably why several new users hit the onboarding spinner bug in support. Also observed: SDK and REST differ on auth retry semantics — REST returns 401 then client tooling triggers token refresh, but SDK client currently retries once then gives up for ephemeral tokens.

kevin: I dug into the node SDK — we map `requestOptions` but explicitly drop unknown top-level keys. `timeout_ms` is being stripped early in the request pipeline. Also the retry wrapper only treats 502/503/504 as retryable; 401 is considered fatal.

sam: On the sample-app side, we just show a spinner and never surface an error when SDK throws. That needs a tiny UX fix (catch + banner).

kevin: Plan proposal: (1) map `timeout_ms` and an alias `timeout` to the underlying fetch/agent timeout so SDK honors the param, (2) update retry policy to invoke the provided token refresh callback on 401 and retry once, (3) add a small integration test that simulates a delayed backend to assert parity.

alex: Agree with that plan. Also let's log a clear error code when a request is aborted due to timeout so sample-app can show a friendly message.

maria: Can we add this to the SDK CHANGELOG and note the behavioral change for enterprise customers? Some Dedicated setups rely on current semantics.

kevin: I'll take the SDK changes and tests. Opening issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/4321 — will draft a PR.

devx-bot: deploy-bot: created branch `fix/timeout-and-auth-retry-4321` for kevin. CI will run once PR is opened.

sam: I'll patch sample-app onboarding to catch `ERR_TIMEOUT` / `401` and show a CTA to retry or contact support.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987 — includes mapping for `timeout_ms`, token-refresh-on-401 hook, and a new integration test using a local proxy. PTAL.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks. After merge can we add a short note to the onboarding quickstart about the `timeout_ms` param (and how it behaves across hosted vs dedicated)?

alex: Yep. I'll follow up with a small docs patch and a sample-app release once the SDK PR lands.

kevin: Will update issue with timeline.

alex: Thanks everyone — this should cut down 1–2 support tickets/week.
